Those are real signs of distributed interest rather than a single operator.

But the recent flow points the other way. Over the last 15 minutes, sell SOL (193) exceeded buy SOL (182), with net outflow of about 10.8 SOL, a 30.6% drop, and 312 sellers against 323 buyers. The coin is down 60% from its 30-minute high, the 30-minute return is -21%, and the sell-to-buy ratio since graduation is 0.86. Buyers are still arriving, but they are not overwhelming sellers, and the bundle share of 23% is not trivial. Nothing here shows demand reasserting itself.

Sellers (312) nearly match buyers (323), so there's no fresh demand absorbing supply.
